status: computed; figure QA passed; independent numerical review recorded separately
scope: Gate 2 descriptive project evidence; no causal or welfare identification
sample: Activity exactly Manufacturing; Mexico, Vietnam, Thailand; all origins, types and statuses; delivered records retained without deduplication
unit: Delivered project record, not verified unique firm, plant or realized project
period_means: Period total divided by the fixed number of calendar years. January-September means are 9-month record counts per calendar year, never multiplied by 4/3 and never called full-year annualized totals.
shares: Pooled within destination and period, count numerator divided by all Manufacturing records in that destination-period. Period shares are not unweighted averages of annual percentages.
zero_cells: A category absent from the delivered sample is counted as zero; this does not verify zero economic activity or full database coverage. A wholly empty denominator would yield null share.

source_groups.Other parents: All others, including Hong Kong and Singapore

sector_scope: All native sectors with Manufacturing activity; no equivalence to existing F03 ISIC sectors asserted
quality_boundary: 2023 Q4 and 2024 excluded. No deduplication, missing-value imputation, amount or employment weighting, first-entry inference or operating-presence inference. Known prior data-delivery concerns remain unresolved.
pandemic_boundary: 2020-2022 is a descriptive period. No pandemic adjustment, policy attribution or identification model is estimated.
statistics: Descriptive counts and shares; no tests or confidence intervals

parent_history.match: Exact Source_Country + NFKC/whitespace/case-normalized Parent_Company + Destination_Country; second version also requires same native Sector
parent_history.meaning: Positive match is recorded project history, not proven operation or verified firm identity. No prior match is not entry. New is not first enterprise entry.
parent_history.unit: Post-period records in matched subgroup, not number of unique parents or continuing plants

contract.core_conclusion: Annual record counts and composition vary across the three destinations and over time; staged comparisons should preserve these paths.
contract.evidence_chain: Columns identify destinations; rows show count, Expansion share and China share from the same annual record universe.

figure.caption: Annual Manufacturing records for Mexico, Vietnam and Thailand, 2014-2022. Every source country, project type and project status is retained. Each percentage uses the destination-year record count as denominator; amounts and jobs are not weights. The pale grey region marks 2020-2022 descriptively and estimates no policy or pandemic effect. Counts refer to delivered records, with unverified uniqueness and coverage. The January-September-only extension through 2023 is tabulated separately.
